translations.sidebar.filesDescription: Open and save files on this device
translations.home.title: Your apps
translations.home.productsDescription: Ten focused tools, connected by one Brightdesk experience.
translations.files.title: Files on this device
translations.files.description: Open a supported file or save your current Brightdesk project. Your work stays on this computer.
translations.files.openDescription: Choose a supported document, spreadsheet, presentation or Brightdesk project from this device.
translations.files.saveDescription: Save your current Brightdesk work to a location you choose on this device.
translations.files.note: Brightdesk does not upload your files to an online storage service.
translations.welcome.sheetsDesc: Organise information, use formulas and build tables.
translations.welcome.slidesDesc: Build a presentation one slide at a time.
translations.welcome.notesDesc: Keep quick notes and reminders together.
translations.manager.chooseDesc: Choose the applications you want available on this computer. You can change this selection later.
translations.manager.manageDesc: Manage the applications available on this computer. Your files remain saved on this device.
translations.manager.note: All application files are included with Brightdesk, so setup works offline. Making an application available does not require an online account. Removing a product from Brightdesk does not delete its documents from this computer.
translations.language.title: Language settings
translations.language.description: Install language packs to change Brightdesk’s menus and tools. Choose a separate proofing language for spelling in your documents.
translations.language.displayDescription: Changes the language used for Brightdesk menus, buttons and tools. Changes apply straight away.
translations.language.proofingDescription: Sets the language used for spelling checks while you write. This setting is separate from the display language.
translations.language.importHelp: You can also install a Brightdesk .bdlang language-pack file from your computer.
translations.language.restartNotNeeded: No restart needed. The display language changes straight away.
translations.language.proofingNative: macOS uses the spelling languages configured in macOS settings.
translations.language.proofingSupported: The selected spelling dictionary is supported by this Brightdesk build.
translations.language.proofingUnavailable: This language pack is installed, but a matching spelling dictionary is not available in this build. The editor language tag will still be set.
translations.language.importFailed: Could not import that language pack.
